title.value: MIDI-DDSP: DETAILED CONTROL OF MUSICAL PERFORMANCE VIA HIERARCHICAL MODELING
title.justification: It's explicitly mentioned in the title section of the document.
title.quote: MIDI-DDSP: DETAILED CONTROL OF MUSICAL PERFORMANCE VIA HIERARCHICAL MODELING

analysis.description: The paper introduces a hierarchical model called MIDI-DDSP that combines realistic neural audio synthesis with detailed user control over musical performance. It utilizes Differentiable Digital Signal Processing (DDSP) to create a 3-level hierarchy (notes, performance, synthesis) that allows for high-fidelity audio reconstruction and assistive creative processes.

type.justification: The study utilizes experiments and tests, such as quantitative experiments and listening tests, to demonstrate the effectiveness of its models.
type.quote: Through quantitative experiments and listening tests, we demonstrate that this hierarchy can reconstruct high-fidelity audio, accurately predict performance attributes for a note sequence, and generate realistic audio from a novel note sequence.

name.justification: The study focuses primarily on generating realistic audio using a hierarchical model, which falls under audio synthesis.
name.quote: MIDI-DDSP a hierarchical model of musical instruments that enables both realistic neural audio synthesis and detailed user control.

name.justification: The paper highlights generating music using a unique model structure.
name.quote: a hierarchical generative model of musical performance to provide both realism and control.

name.justification: MIDI-DDSP is a primary model introduced and explored in the paper for audio synthesis and user control.
name.quote: In this work, we introduce MIDI-DDSP a hierarchical model of musical instruments that enables both realistic neural audio synthesis and detailed user control.

is_contributed.justification: The MIDI-DDSP model is proposed as a novel solution by the authors of this paper.
is_contributed.quote: We propose MIDI-DDSP, a 3-level hierarchical generative model of music (notes, performance, synthesis).

is_executed.justification: The model was implemented and tested, including quantitative experiments and listening tests.

is_compared.justification: MIDI-DDSP is compared against other systems, including MIDI2Params, FluidSynth, and Ableton, in listening tests to show its effectiveness.
is_compared.quote: MIDI-DDSP was significantly preferred over MIDI2Params, Ableton, and FluidSynth.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The MIDI2Params model is referenced multiple times in the document as a comparative study to show MIDI-DDSP's effectiveness.
referenced_paper_title.quote: We extensively compare to our reimplementation of MIDI2Params as a baseline throughout the paper.

name.quote: To demonstrate modeling a variety of instruments, we use the URMP dataset (Li et al., 2018), a publicly-available audio dataset containing monophonic solo performances of a variety of instruments.
